summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases of 9,595,000 Class B shares at an average price of SEK 98.48 per share for a total of approximately SEK 944.9 million, as part of a previously announced buyback program of up to SEK 15 billion running from April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares (except those for incentive plans) at the 2027 AGM. Purchases are executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE under the EU Safe Harbour Regulation. After these repurchases, Ericsson holds 79,198,312 treasury shares. Watch for program completion pace and any acceleration that could signal management's view on undervaluation.
